% Log-only native probe; intentionally outside the rendered fixture directory.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pgf}
\usepgflibrary{fpu}
\newcommand{\probe}[1]{\pgfmathparse{#1}\typeout{PROBE:#1=\pgfmathresult}}
\begin{document}
\probe{round(-2.5)}\probe{round(-1.5)}\probe{round(-.5)}
\probe{round(.5)}\probe{round(2.5)}\probe{round(-.1)}
\probe{mod(-5,3)}\probe{mod(5,-3)}\probe{mod(-5,-3)}
\probe{Mod(-5,3)}\probe{Mod(5,-3)}\probe{Mod(-5,-3)}
\probe{mod(-6,3)}\probe{Mod(-6,3)}
% Fixed-point boundaries are recorded, not claimed as repaired by this slice.
\probe{round(-2.49999)}\probe{round(-2.499999)}
\pgfkeys{/pgf/fpu=true,/pgf/fpu/output format=fixed}
\probe{round(-2.5)}\probe{round(-1.5)}\probe{round(-.5)}
\probe{mod(-5,3)}\probe{mod(5,-3)}\probe{mod(-5,-3)}
\end{document}
